caption:
A defence company just signed up to build chip-packaging tech India has never made before. A Rs 6,200 crore facility, on 50 acres in Madhya Pradesh.

Paras Semiconductors, a subsidiary of Paras Defence and Space Technologies, signed an MoU with the Madhya Pradesh government on July 22, 2026 for a greenfield facility on the Indore-Ujjain corridor. It's designed for advanced techniques India has barely attempted commercially - 3D heterogeneous integration, hybrid bonding, chiplet integration and flip-chip assembly. The project sits inside the India Semiconductor Mission's second phase, with reports pointing to over 2,500 direct jobs.

Most semiconductor deals so far have been about basic assembly and testing. This one is aimed at packaging techniques India has never built at commercial scale.

Sources: The Week, Angel One (2026)
